integrity: A complete mathematical proof combines a self-contained occurrence-label bound with two separate exact finite verifiers; one verifier independently enumerates all maximal cliques. Neither finite program is used to assert an unbounded proof. External independent validation has not been performed.
limitations: Applies only to unordered positive-integer partitions into exactly four parts, with multiplicity-two pairwise intersection. The exact computation covers orders 4 through 29; the universal bound handles orders 30 onward. The exceptional order-nine witness and the thirteen-member nontrivial upper bound are closely related to published prior results. No claim is made for all small-order extremizers, other lengths or thresholds, or unindexed literature.
title: The \((4,2)\) intersection theorem for integer partitions
